nouns.name: session
nouns.summary: Inspect, list, rename, view and manage Sessions.

nouns.name: history
nouns.summary: Read archived conversation context and search history.

nouns.name: agent
nouns.summary: List and manage Agents, their rules and inheritance.

nouns.name: node
nouns.summary: List, select and manage Nodes; copy files between them.

nouns.name: memory
nouns.summary: Read and change files in this Agent's memory directory.

nouns.name: image
nouns.summary: Save, crop or generate images from this Session.

nouns.name: artifact
nouns.summary: Prepare, publish or inspect WebUI artifacts.

nouns.name: timer
nouns.summary: Schedule, list, change and delete timers.

nouns.name: config
nouns.summary: Install configuration and explain tool authorization.

nouns.name: mcp
nouns.summary: List and configure MCP servers and their notifications.

nouns.name: tool
nouns.summary: Find and call any builtin, MCP or Node tool.

commands.summary: Show a Session's status: Node, working directory, model, context usage and recent children.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to inspect. Defaults to this Session.

commands.summary: List Sessions, the current Agent's by default.

params.name: query
params.help: Keeps Sessions whose ID, alias, display name, Agent, Node, working directory or model contains this text, ignoring case. Applied before --start and --count.

params.name: start
params.help: Zero-based offset, ordered by most recent activity. Defaults to 0.

params.name: count
params.help: Number of Sessions to return. Defaults to 20.

params.name: scope
params.help: current-agent (default), or all to include Sessions from other Agents.

commands.summary: Set or clear a Session's display name.

params.name: name
params.help: New display name. An empty string clears it.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to rename. Defaults to this Session.

commands.summary: Change a Session's parent.

params.name: parentSessionId
params.help: Existing Session ID to use as the parent.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to change. Defaults to this Session.

commands.summary: Remove a Session's parent.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to change. Defaults to this Session.

commands.summary: Read a Session's current conversation and execution state.
commands.help: Defaults to the latest 10 visible records, with tools summarized by name and count. Use --parts to select content and the returned older-page command to continue reading. Use `ctl history recall` for archived originals.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to read.

params.name: start
params.help: Active-history index to read forward from. Negative values count from the end. Omit --start and --before to read the newest page; do not combine them.

params.name: before
params.help: Exclusive active-history index to read backward from. Use the value returned for the older page; do not combine with --start.

params.name: count
params.help: Maximum visible source records to select after applying --parts. Defaults to 10; 0 returns only the header and execution state. Text filters can leave fewer matches.

params.name: historyVersion
params.help: History version returned by an earlier view. Give it with --start or --before to detect a structurally changed range.

params.name: parts
params.help: Content to show: text, tools or images; repeat for several. Defaults to all three. Hiding tools preserves commentary in mixed messages; text and images belonging to tool results stay with tools.

params.name: previewLength
params.help: Total character budget for the response. Omit or use 0 for the default; other values are bounded to 1,000–20,000.

params.name: contentFilter
params.help: Keep selected records containing this literal text, ignoring case. Searches the included content of the selected page, not the entire history.

params.name: includeRegex
params.help: Keep selected records whose included content matches this regular expression, ignoring case.

params.name: excludeRegex
params.help: Exclude selected records whose included content matches this regular expression, ignoring case.

params.name: toolDetail
params.help: names (default) shows compact tool activity; snippets adds short argument and result excerpts; full includes complete tool content within the preview budget.

commands.summary: Create a Session under an existing Agent.
commands.help: The new Session reuses the Agent's memory and workspace.

params.name: agentName
params.help: Existing Agent that will own the Session.

params.name: sessionName
params.help: Session name without the Agent prefix. Use only ASCII letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.

params.name: runtime
params.help: Model loop for the new Session: foxwarm (default), or claude-code using the installed Claude Code configuration. The runtime can only be chosen at creation.

params.name: displayName
params.help: Display name for the new Session.

params.name: parentSessionId
params.help: Existing Session to record as the new Session's parent.

params.name: node
params.help: Node for the new Session. If omitted, use the target Agent's default Node, then the installation default, then master; a recorded parent does not affect placement.

params.name: systemPromptFiles
params.help: Memory source files for the new prompt snapshot; repeat for several. When given, these replace the default memory-file selection; other system instructions remain.

params.name: model
params.help: Model suited to this task, by key from the available models in your instructions. This Session's child settings, which the user may have chosen, take precedence. Omit to use the normal defaults.

params.name: effort
params.help: Effort level suited to this task. Can be given without --model to apply to the otherwise selected model.

params.name: forceModel
params.help: Only when the user explicitly requests a model for this task or Session. Takes precedence over --model and this Session's child settings.

params.name: forceEffort
params.help: Only when the user explicitly requests an effort level for this task or Session. Takes precedence over --effort and this Session's child settings.

commands.summary: Rename a Session or move it to another Agent.
commands.help: Can also create the destination Agent. The old Session ID remains an alias.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to move, identified by its ID or an unambiguous alias. Defaults to this Session.

params.name: newSessionId
params.help: New Session name without an Agent prefix or /. Required unless --create-agent is set, when it defaults to main.

params.name: createAgent
params.help: Create the destination Agent. Defaults to false.

params.name: newAgentName
params.help: Destination Agent. Required with --create-agent or when moving to another Agent; omit to rename within the source Agent.

params.name: createAgentInheritMemory
params.help: Copy the source Agent's memory when creating the destination Agent. Defaults to false.

params.name: parentSessionId
params.help: Existing parent Session to assign after the move. Omit to keep the current parent.

commands.summary: Delete another Session's live record, keeping its archived history.
commands.help: Surviving children are detached. A busy target receives a stop request; retry deletion after it becomes idle. The current Session cannot delete itself.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to delete, identified by its ID or an unambiguous alias.

commands.summary: Ask a running Session to stop its current turn.
commands.help: An in-flight model request may be aborted; a tool already running may need to finish.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to stop.

commands.summary: Rebuild a Session's prompt snapshot now.
commands.help: Use after changes to memory, inheritance or available skills, without waiting for an automatic refresh.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to refresh now, even if it has been inactive for more than an hour. Defaults to this Session.

commands.summary: Show or change the default model and effort for new child Sessions.
commands.help: Applies to future child or related new Sessions. Unset settings follow the source Session's normal model and effort defaults.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session whose defaults to inspect or change. Defaults to this Session.

params.name: model
params.help: Configured model key for future child or related new Sessions.

params.name: effort
params.help: Effort setting; use default or unset to clear the override.

params.name: clear
params.help: Clear only the model override. Do not combine with --model.

commands.summary: Show or change the automatic compaction threshold.
commands.help: Without an override, the threshold follows the active model's context window.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to inspect or change. Defaults to this Session.

params.name: thresholdTokens
params.help: Token threshold for automatic compaction. Omit to inspect the current setting.

params.name: clear
params.help: Remove the override and use the model-derived default.

commands.summary: Start compaction for this or another idle Session.
commands.help: The target uses a separate planning turn to produce a summary plan with submit_compact_plan; this command does not return the candidates or supply the final summary.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to compact. Defaults to this Session.

params.name: summary
params.help: Additional instructions for the compaction planner, not the final summary or plan.

params.name: keepPercent
params.help: Recent history to keep unsummarized, measured in tokens as a share of the automatic compaction threshold, or of the current unsummarized history when that is smaller: a fraction greater than 0 and up to 1, or a percentage greater than 1 and up to 100. Defaults to the configured share.

commands.summary: Read archived context by reference, or search it literally or by meaning.
commands.help: Give a <target> for known message or block references, --text-query for a bounded literal search in one Session without Vector, or --vector-query for semantic search. Filters narrow the selected results; they do not search unselected history.

params.name: target
params.help: What to open: overview (default), blocks, B#126, msg:B#126 or msg#10637-10680. block#126 is also accepted. Message numbers are Archive sequences, not active-history indices. Omit with --text-query or --vector-query.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session for exact lookup or literal search. Defaults to this Session.

params.name: vector_query
params.help: Search earlier context by meaning and return matching source messages or block summaries.

params.name: limit
params.help: Maximum search results. Defaults to 5, up to 20.

params.name: cursor
params.help: Opaque continuation cursor returned by a semantic search. Continues the same bounded ranked window; keep the query, filters, scope, time range and --limit unchanged. If the cursor expires, start a new search.

params.name: startTime
params.help: Inclusive ISO-8601 lower bound for semantic results, in UTC.

params.name: endTime
params.help: Exclusive ISO-8601 upper bound for semantic results, in UTC.

params.name: scope
params.help: Scope for semantic search: current-session, or current-agent for every Session of this Agent (default).

params.name: previewLength
params.help: Total character budget for preview text. Omit or use 0 for the default; other values are bounded to 1,000–20,000. ToolScript exact-message reads return complete canonical JSON within ToolScript data limits.

params.name: contentFilter
params.help: Keep retrieved items containing this text, ignoring case, and show the matching area when possible. Omit to read the complete selected context.

params.name: includeRegex
params.help: Keep retrieved items matching this regular expression, ignoring case.

params.name: excludeRegex
params.help: Exclude retrieved items matching this regular expression, ignoring case.

params.name: preferBlocks
params.help: Give context-block summaries a small ranking preference in semantic search.

params.name: toolDetail
params.help: names (default) shows compact tool activity; snippets adds short argument and result excerpts; full includes complete tool content within the preview budget.

params.name: text_query
params.help: Literal text to find in archived messages of one Session, ignoring case. Reads a bounded range and reports its extent and older continuation. Do not combine with <target> or --vector-query.

params.name: beforeSeq
params.help: Exclusive Archive message sequence for continuing a --text-query into older messages. Omit to search from the newest messages.

commands.summary: Read archived messages by sequence number.
commands.help: Includes messages no longer present in the active conversation.

params.name: startSeq
params.help: First message sequence number to include.

params.name: endSeq
params.help: Last message sequence number to include.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to read. Defaults to this Session.

params.name: previewLength
params.help: Total character budget for the response. Defaults to 1,000; values are bounded to 1,000–20,000.

commands.summary: Read archived context-block summaries by block ID.

params.name: startId
params.help: First block ID to include.

params.name: endId
params.help: Last block ID to include.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session to read. Defaults to this Session.

params.name: previewLength
params.help: Total character budget for the response. Defaults to 1,000; values are bounded to 1,000–20,000.

commands.summary: List Agents with Session counts, memory, inheritance and rule summaries.
commands.help: The list shows your own Agent and the Agents your tool policy may let you use.

commands.summary: Create an Agent with its own workspace and memory.
commands.help: A main Session is also created by default. Use `ctl session create` instead when you only need another conversation under an existing Agent.

params.name: agentName
params.help: New Agent name, using letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.

params.name: createMainSession
params.help: Also create the Agent's main Session. Defaults to true.

params.name: inherit
params.help: Agent whose memory should be inherited by the new Agent.

params.name: inheritMemory
params.help: Copy memory files from the source Agent once. Use --inherit for ongoing shared-memory inheritance.

params.name: sourceSessionId
params.help: Session whose model provides creation defaults. Defaults to this Session.

params.name: convertSession
params.help: Convert an existing Session into this Agent's main Session. Requires --create-main-session.

params.name: rules
params.help: Initial local authorization rules for the new Agent, evaluated in order; pass a JSON array, usually as @name. Calls that match no rule pass this layer, so end with {"action":"deny"} to allow only the listed capabilities. Omit for an empty layer; ancestor rules still apply.

params.name: defaultNode
params.help: Default execution Node for new Sessions in this Agent; omitted uses the installation default when configured. This chooses initial placement and does not grant access.

params.name: defaultCwd
params.help: Absolute working directory for new Sessions that start on the effective default Node (the installation default, else master, when --default-node is omitted). This sets the initial cwd and does not grant access.

commands.summary: Replace an Agent's local authorization rules.
commands.help: You may change only strict descendants; ancestor restrictions still apply.

params.name: agentName
params.help: Agent whose local rules to replace.

params.name: rules
params.help: Complete replacement rule list, evaluated in order; pass a JSON array, usually as @name. Calls that match no rule pass this layer, so end with {"action":"deny"} to allow only the listed capabilities. An empty list removes this layer's rules. Caller selectors are not accepted.

commands.summary: Set or clear an Agent's shared-memory inheritance.
commands.help: Memory is included from the oldest ancestor through the Agent itself; files with the same name are not deduplicated. Existing Session snapshots are unchanged unless --refresh-snapshots is set.

params.name: agentName
params.help: Agent to update.

params.name: inheritAgentName
params.help: Agent to inherit from. An empty string clears inheritance.

params.name: refreshSnapshots
params.help: Refresh snapshots now for this Agent and its inheriting Agents, skipping Sessions inactive for more than one hour because they refresh automatically when their next turn starts. Defaults to false.

commands.summary: List Nodes and Providers.
Select this Session's execution Node.

params.name: nodeId
params.help: Node to select.

commands.summary: Show Node or Provider details.

params.name: nodeId
params.help: Node to inspect. Give either a Node or --provider-id.

params.name: providerId
params.help: Configured Provider to inspect instead of a Node.

commands.summary: Create a Node through its Provider.

params.name: nodeId
params.help: Requested ID for the new Node.

params.name: providerId
params.help: Configured Provider that creates the Node.

params.name: parameters
params.help: Provider-specific options for the lifecycle operation.

commands.summary: Create a Node through its Provider unless it already exists.

params.name: nodeId
params.help: Requested Node ID. Required when your Agent was created by another Agent; without it, Node-subtree permissions can't be checked before the Provider runs.

params.name: providerId
params.help: Configured Provider that creates or reconnects the Node.

params.name: parameters
params.help: Provider-specific options for the lifecycle operation.

commands.summary: Request a Node's removal through its Provider.

params.name: nodeId
params.help: Node to destroy. Its own Provider performs the removal.

params.name: confirmation
params.help: Exactly `destroy node <node-id>`.

commands.summary: Copy a file between Nodes, including master.
commands.help: Both paths are checked against the applicable permissions. If the copy outlasts --timeout, it continues in the background and returns a transfer ID; a later event reports completion. Stop or Run queued ends the wait without cancelling the copy; use `ctl node cancel-transfer` to stop it.

params.name: sourceNode
params.help: Node containing the source file.

params.name: sourcePath
params.help: Source file path on <source-node>. A relative path uses the Session working directory when the Node is this Session's current Node and a working directory is set, otherwise the Node's default directory (the Agent directory on master and CLI Nodes). On master and CLI Nodes, ~/ and a leading $fw_agentdir or $fw_tmp are accepted; other leading $ names are rejected.

params.name: targetNode
params.help: Node that will receive the file.

params.name: targetPath
params.help: Destination file path on <target-node>. Relative paths follow the same rule as <source-path>.

params.name: overwrite
params.help: Allow replacement of an existing destination file. Defaults to false.

params.name: timeout
params.help: Seconds to wait before returning a still-running copy as a background transfer. Defaults to 15; values above 60 are reduced to 60 with a warning.

commands.summary: Cancel a background copy started by `node copy`.
commands.help: Only copies started in this Session. Already transferred bytes are not undone: an unfinished copy publishes nothing on master and CLI Nodes, while other Nodes may keep a partial destination file.

params.name: transferId
params.help: Transfer ID returned by `node copy`.

commands.summary: Reserve a Node ID and write its auth token to a private file on master.
commands.help: Returns the Node ID and file path, never the token. Existing Node IDs and files are not replaced. Use run_script with file transfer or exec tools to configure the Node without putting the token in tool arguments or output.

params.name: nodeId
params.help: New Node ID to reserve. Existing IDs are rejected; this does not rotate an existing credential.

params.name: parentNode
params.help: Existing Node whose authorization subtree will contain the new Node. Required for callers in an Agent created by another Agent; omission otherwise creates a root.

params.name: filePath
params.help: Absolute path on master for the new token file. Its parent directory must already exist. The file is created with owner-only permissions and contains the token followed by a newline.

commands.summary: Revoke an approved Node's credentials and disconnect it.
commands.help: Nodes with descendants require --cascade. Does not stop client processes or delete environments, files, Agents or Sessions.

params.name: nodeId
params.help: Approved Node ID to remove.

params.name: cascade
params.help: Also revoke approved descendants. Each removal must be authorized before any change. A subtree containing executable-provider Nodes is rejected.

commands.summary: Get Node setup instructions and bootstrap endpoints.
commands.help: The pairing token is written to --file-path, a new owner-only file on master; the returned commands show PAIRING_TOKEN in its place, so supply the file's contents when running them on the new Node. Commands use config.url when set; otherwise replace the example address with one reachable from the new Node.

params.name: filePath
params.help: Absolute path on master for a new file that receives the pairing token. The file must not already exist.

commands.summary: List Node pairing requests awaiting approval.
Approve a pending Node pairing request.
commands.help: First check `ctl node pair-list` and verify the request is from the Node you intend to trust. Callers in an Agent created by another Agent must use `ctl node token` with --parent-node instead.

params.name: pendingId
params.help: Pending request ID from `node pair-list`.

params.name: nodeId
params.help: Node ID to assign. Defaults to the requested name.

commands.summary: Read a memory file.
commands.help: The file is in this Agent's memory directory on master. Use memory-relative paths such as MEMORY.md or notes/project.md.

params.name: filePath
params.help: Path relative to this Agent's memory directory, without a memory/ prefix.

params.name: startLine
params.help: First line to read, counting from 1. Omit or use 0 to start at the beginning.

params.name: endLine
params.help: Last line to read, counting from 1. Omit or use 0 to read through the end.

commands.summary: Create a memory file.
commands.help: Existing files are not overwritten; use `ctl memory edit` to modify one. Top-level .md files in this directory are part of the system prompt of every Session of this Agent and of Agents that inherit it.

params.name: filePath
params.help: Path relative to this Agent's memory directory, without a memory/ prefix.

params.name: content
params.help: Complete file contents.

commands.summary: Replace one exact occurrence of text in a memory file.
commands.help: Top-level .md files in this directory are part of the system prompt of every Session of this Agent and of Agents that inherit it.

params.name: filePath
params.help: Path relative to this Agent's memory directory, without a memory/ prefix.

params.name: oldText
params.help: Exact text to replace; it must identify a single occurrence.

params.name: newText
params.help: Replacement text.

commands.summary: Delete a memory file.

params.name: filePath
params.help: Path relative to this Agent's memory directory, without a memory/ prefix.

commands.summary: Change memory files with an apply_patch patch.
commands.help: Adds, modifies or deletes files in this Agent's memory directory on master. Paths in patch headers are relative to the memory directory; a memory/ prefix is also accepted. Top-level .md files in this directory are part of the system prompt of every Session of this Agent and of Agents that inherit it.

params.name: input
params.help: Patch text using the same format as apply_patch.

commands.summary: List available skills.

params.name: agentName
params.help: Agent whose available skills to use. Defaults to this Session's Agent.

commands.summary: Read a skill's instructions and resource list.

params.name: skillName
params.help: Skill to read.

params.name: agentName
params.help: Agent whose available skills to use. Defaults to this Session's Agent.

commands.summary: Deliver a file or image from a Node to users.
commands.help: Give either one --channel-target-id or a --session-id whose attached channels should receive it. With neither, delivery uses the current Session.

params.name: filePath
params.help: File path on the selected Node. A relative path uses the Session working directory when the Node is this Session's current Node and a working directory is set, otherwise the Node's default directory (the Agent directory on master and CLI Nodes). On master and CLI Nodes, ~/ and a leading $fw_agentdir or $fw_tmp are accepted; other leading $ names are rejected.

params.name: channelTargetId
params.help: One destination in the form <channel-instance-id>:<conversation-id>. Do not combine with --session-id.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session whose attached channels should receive the file. Defaults to the current Session; do not combine with --channel-target-id.

params.name: node
params.help: Node containing the file. Defaults to the current Node.

params.name: caption
params.help: Text to accompany the file, where the destination supports captions.

commands.summary: Save an image from this Session to a file.
commands.help: Works for generated images and images returned by tools. The saved file can be reused or delivered with `ctl file send`.

params.name: id
params.help: Image ID shown in this Session.

params.name: filePath
params.help: File path on the selected Node. A relative path uses the Session working directory when the Node is this Session's current Node and a working directory is set, otherwise the Node's default directory (the Agent directory on master and CLI Nodes). On master and CLI Nodes, ~/ and a leading $fw_agentdir or $fw_tmp are accepted; other leading $ names are rejected.

params.name: overwrite
params.help: Allow replacement of an existing file. Defaults to false.

params.name: node
params.help: Node on which to save the image. Defaults to the current Node.

commands.summary: Crop an image from this Session.
commands.help: Works for generated images and images returned by tools. Returns a new visible image, which can be cropped, saved or delivered again. GIF input uses its first frame and returns a PNG, without animation. Coordinates and dimensions refer to the original image, before resizing for model input.

params.name: id
params.help: Image ID shown in this Session.

params.name: x
params.help: Left edge of the crop, in pixels.

params.name: y
params.help: Top edge of the crop, in pixels.

params.name: width
params.help: Crop width in pixels.

params.name: height
params.help: Crop height in pixels.

commands.summary: Generate or edit an image with the configured image service.
commands.help: Uses the selected model's image service. Returns visible images that can be saved or delivered with the image commands. Use --image-ids to reference images from this Session for edits; describe the requested result in <prompt>.

params.name: prompt
params.help: Describe the image to generate or the edit to make.

params.name: imageIds
params.help: Optional source images for editing or visual reference.

commands.summary: Prepare an artifact marker for insertion between prose paragraphs.

params.name: filePath
params.help: Self-contained JSON manifest (2 MiB), or raster image with `--type image` (12 MiB), on the source Node.

params.name: type
params.help: Use for PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP image files. Omit for JSON chart/React manifests.

params.name: title
params.help: Optional image title; otherwise its filename.

params.name: alt
params.help: Optional accessible image description.

params.name: node
params.help: Source Node; defaults to the current Session Node.

commands.summary: Publish an artifact as a standalone reply card.

params.name: filePath
params.help: Self-contained JSON manifest (2 MiB), or raster image with `--type image` (12 MiB), on the source Node.

params.name: type
params.help: Use for PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP image files. Omit for JSON chart/React manifests.

params.name: title
params.help: Optional image title; otherwise its filename.

params.name: alt
params.help: Optional accessible image description.

params.name: node
params.help: Source Node; defaults to the current Session Node.

params.name: artifactId
params.help: Existing artifact ID when publishing a new revision.

params.name: expectedRevision
params.help: Required previous revision for an update; conflicts are rejected.

commands.summary: Show artifact publication metadata.

params.name: artifactId
params.help: Artifact to inspect.

params.name: revision
params.help: Specific revision; omit for the latest publication metadata.

commands.summary: Send a message to a channel destination.
commands.help: The destination does not need a Session attachment. For a normal-mode channel attached to this Session, reply directly instead: your assistant text is delivered automatically. Use this command for send-only channels or when the work requires delivery to a different destination.

params.name: channelTargetId
params.help: Destination in the form <channel-instance-id>:<conversation-id>.

params.name: message
params.help: Message to deliver.

commands.summary: Schedule a message or a ToolScript run.
commands.help: Runs once or on a recurring schedule; give one of --at, --after-seconds or --cron. ToolScript timers run for the calling Session without starting a model turn; the script can send a message when needed. Timers survive restarts. Load the timer-automation skill before creating or changing timers.

params.name: action
params.help: What each trigger does: message (default) or toolscript.

params.name: script
params.help: ToolScript to run on each trigger with `--action toolscript`, as a JSON object, usually @name.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Session that owns the timer. Defaults to this Session. ToolScript timers must belong to the calling Session.

params.name: at
params.help: One-time trigger time as an ISO date-time string or Unix epoch milliseconds.

params.name: afterSeconds
params.help: Seconds from now until a one-time trigger.

params.name: cron
params.help: Cron schedule for recurring triggers.

params.name: message
params.help: Message delivered on each trigger with `--action message` (the default).

params.name: newSession
params.help: Deliver each message trigger to a newly created Session instead of the owner Session.

params.name: sessionPrefix
params.help: Name prefix for newly created Sessions. Defaults to timer; applies to message timers when --new-session is true.

params.name: agentName
params.help: Agent for newly created Sessions. Defaults to the owner Session's Agent; applies to message timers when --new-session is true.

commands.summary: List timers owned by a Session.
commands.help: Shows each timer's schedule, next run, paused state and most recent result.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Owner Session ID. Defaults to this Session.

commands.summary: Change a timer.
commands.help: Omitted options keep their current values. To change its schedule, give exactly one of --at, --after-seconds or --cron. A supplied --script replaces the complete script specification. Load the timer-automation skill before changing timers.

params.name: timerId
params.help: Timer to update.

params.name: action
params.help: Replacement trigger action. Give the --message or --script required by the new action.

params.name: script
params.help: Complete replacement ToolScript specification for future triggers, as a JSON object, usually @name.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Owner Session ID. Defaults to this Session. Only the owner Session may configure a ToolScript timer.

params.name: at
params.help: New one-time trigger time as an ISO date-time string or Unix epoch milliseconds.

params.name: afterSeconds
params.help: Seconds from now until the rescheduled one-time trigger.

params.name: cron
params.help: New recurring cron schedule.

params.name: message
params.help: Replacement message for future message triggers.

params.name: newSession
params.help: Use a new Session for each message trigger. --no-new-session returns message delivery to the owner and clears new-Session target settings.

params.name: sessionPrefix
params.help: Name prefix for new Sessions; applies to message timers when --new-session is true.

params.name: agentName
params.help: Agent for new Sessions; applies to message timers when --new-session is true and defaults to the owner Session's Agent.

params.name: paused
params.help: --paused stops the timer from firing while keeping its schedule and settings; --no-paused resumes it from the next scheduled time. Missed times are not replayed; a one-time timer whose time has passed fires once on resume.

commands.summary: Pause a timer, keeping its schedule.

params.name: timerId
params.help: Timer to pause.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Owner Session ID. Defaults to this Session. Only the owner Session may configure a ToolScript timer.

commands.summary: Resume a paused timer from its next scheduled time.

params.name: timerId
params.help: Timer to resume.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Owner Session ID. Defaults to this Session. Only the owner Session may configure a ToolScript timer.

commands.summary: Delete a timer.
commands.help: Stops future triggers. A delivery already in progress is not undone.

params.name: timerId
params.help: Timer to delete.

params.name: sessionId
params.help: Owner Session ID. Defaults to this Session.

commands.summary: List this Session's ToolScript runs.
commands.help: Shows each run's status and progress summary.

params.name: limit
params.help: Maximum runs to return. Defaults to 20, up to 200.

params.name: status
params.help: Include only runs with this status.

commands.summary: Inspect a ToolScript run.
commands.help: Shows its status, pause details, accumulated output and tool activity.

params.name: runId
params.help: Run to inspect.

commands.summary: Cancel a ToolScript run owned by this Session.
commands.help: Cancels a waiting run, or requests cancellation of an active one. Already started tool effects are not undone.

params.name: runId
params.help: Run to cancel.

commands.summary: Install a complete YAML configuration from a file on master.
commands.help: The candidate is validated before replacing the active file. The result identifies applied changes and settings that require a restart. Your current permissions must allow both this operation and reading the candidate file.

params.name: target
params.help: Configuration to replace: config for app settings, models for model providers and models, or tool-rules for the instance tool authorization policy.

params.name: filePath
params.help: Path on master to the complete candidate YAML file. A leading $fw_agentdir or $fw_tmp expands to this Agent's directory or its tmp directory on master. Other leading $ names are rejected.

commands.summary: Explain how tool authorization would decide a call, without running it.
commands.help: Each probe names the caller Session and the tool, as for `ctl tool call`. The result shows the decision and matching rule of the global policy and of each Agent rule layer, and the facts used. Checks made inside the tool itself are not included. With --policy-file-path, a candidate file replaces the global policy; add --compare to evaluate both and list changed rule IDs. Requires permission to read the active policy file and any candidate on master; probing another Session also requires permission to view it.

params.name: probes
params.help: Calls to evaluate, as a JSON array, usually @name. Each probe has `sessionId`, `toolId` (or `source` and `name`, plus `server` or `nodeId`) and `args`.

params.name: policyFilePath
params.help: Path on master to a complete candidate tool-rules YAML that replaces the active global policy. A leading $fw_agentdir or $fw_tmp expands to this Agent's directory or its tmp directory on master.

params.name: compare
params.help: With --policy-file-path, evaluate both the active and candidate policy and include a static rule id diff.

commands.summary: Store a credential under a new secret name.
commands.help: Configuration can then refer to it as `${secret:NAME}`, and its value is hidden from tool output, Session history and model requests. Give exactly one source: --value, --file-path or --from-config. An existing name can't be replaced here; the user replaces values in Setup. Stored values can't be read back.

params.name: name
params.help: New secret name: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`, starting with a letter or digit.

params.name: description
params.help: Optional one-line description shown in Setup and `ctl secret list`.

params.name: value
params.help: The credential. It remains visible in this command, so prefer --file-path when the value is in a file or comes from a command's output.

params.name: filePath
params.help: File on your current Node containing the value: UTF-8 text, at most 64 KiB. A single trailing line break is ignored.

params.name: deleteFile
params.help: Delete the file after storing its value.

params.name: fromConfig
params.help: Configuration fields that currently hold the same literal credential; repeat for several. Each field is changed to refer to the new secret, which belongs to the instance rather than your Agent.

commands.summary: List secret names, owners and usage, never values.
commands.help: Includes descriptions, owners and the configuration that uses each secret, and referenced names that have no value yet. `usable` tells whether your permissions let you use each stored secret from your current Node.

commands.summary: List configured MCP servers.
commands.help: Includes disabled servers, with redacted connection summaries. A null `timeoutSeconds` means the default of 60 seconds is used.

commands.summary: Add, update or disable an MCP server connection.
commands.help: Successful changes apply to subsequent calls without restarting Foxwarm; use --no-enable to disable a server. Load the mcp-management skill before changing connections. Use this command rather than editing the configuration file when the change must apply immediately.

params.name: name
params.help: Name identifying the server.

params.name: url
params.help: MCP endpoint URL. Use its streamable HTTP endpoint for streamable-http or auto, or its SSE endpoint for sse.

params.name: command
params.help: Executable to start for stdio transport.

params.name: args
params.help: Command-line argument for the stdio server; repeat for each.

params.name: env
params.help: Additional environment variables for the stdio server, as a JSON object.

params.name: cwd
params.help: Working directory for the stdio server.

params.name: stderr
params.help: How to handle the stdio server's standard error stream: inherit, pipe, or ignore.

params.name: token
params.help: Bearer token for the Authorization header.

params.name: headers
params.help: HTTP request headers as a JSON object. An explicit Authorization header takes precedence over --token.

params.name: transport
params.help: Connection transport. Defaults to auto.

params.name: description
params.help: Short description of the server.

params.name: timeoutSeconds
params.help: Time limit for calls to this server, in seconds, from 1 to 3,600. Use 0 to restore the default of 60 seconds. Does not change connection or tool-listing timeouts.

params.name: enable
params.help: Whether this server is enabled.

commands.summary: Start, stop or inspect message notifications from an MCP server.
commands.help: Notifications are for the current Session and require Streamable HTTP and Foxwarm notification support. Calls to the server share this Session's connection. Incoming messages enter this Session's normal queue only while reception is enabled; disconnected messages are not replayed. See the mcp-management skill for setup and explicit replies between instances.

params.name: action
params.help: Operation to perform.

params.name: server
params.help: Configured MCP server name.

commands.summary: Find builtin, MCP and Node tools and their argument schemas.
commands.help: Matches tool names and descriptions. Results show each tool's ID, its arguments and, for builtins, the matching command. Call a result with `ctl tool call <tool-id> --args @args`.

params.name: query
params.help: Words to match in tool names and descriptions. Results matching more words rank higher. Omit to list tools.

params.name: source
params.help: Source to search; repeat for several. Defaults to builtin, mcp and node.

params.name: server
params.help: Limit MCP results to this server. Omit to search all enabled MCP servers.

params.name: nodeId
params.help: Node to search. Omit or use current to search this Session's execution Node.

params.name: limit
params.help: Maximum results. Defaults to 5, up to 200.

params.name: schema
params.help: Include argument schemas for up to the first 10 results. Defaults to true; --no-schema shows short summaries.

commands.summary: Call a builtin, MCP or Node tool by its tool ID.
commands.help: Give a <tool-id> from `ctl tool search`, or identify the tool with --source and --name plus --server or --node-id when needed. Pass the tool's arguments as one object with --args @args. The target tool's normal checks apply.

params.name: toolId
params.help: Tool ID from `ctl tool search`, such as builtin:session, mcp:server/tool or node:master/read.

params.name: source
params.help: Tool source when not giving a <tool-id>.

params.name: name
params.help: Tool name when not giving a <tool-id>.

params.name: server
params.help: MCP server name. Required for `--source mcp` unless included in the <tool-id>.

params.name: nodeId
params.help: Node for `--source node`. Omit or use current for this Session's current Node.

params.name: args
params.help: Arguments for the selected tool, as a JSON object, usually @args. Defaults to no arguments.
